seedUsedFor: the 100 joint layouts only; every lattice is enumerated
pose: t = launch delay + flight seconds. Distance along the segment is a triangular wave at target.speed. t = 0 is endpoints[0]. Idle time is not added.
win: any recorded projectile contact with worldcraft-target-bell before the incumbent ledger closes

classMeaning.both: ramp and bank both contacted before the bell
classMeaning.ramp-only: ramp contacted before the bell and the bank was not
classMeaning.bank-only: bank contacted before the bell and the ramp was not

linkage.note: clusters group layouts, not delays. A cluster is kept at size >= 3.

nudgeDefinition.yaw: one movable piece at a time, yaw ±5 degrees, same delay. Invalid placements count as applicable and not survived.
nudgeDefinition.delay: same layout, delay ±0.5 s. A step outside 0–10 s is not applicable.
nudgeDefinition.aim: kept-cluster medoids only. Launch yaw ±5° and launch elevation (pitch) ±5° from the fixed rail (0°, 18°). Not a player control on this challenge.
